channel.title: Global Arbitration Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Arbitration Review (globalarbitrationreview.com)

item.title: Burundi faces another mining claim
item.description: A second investor has filed a contractual ICSID claim against Burundi after the east African state sought to renegotiate its partnerships with several mining companies.

item.title: London set suspends French arbitrator over Epstein emails
item.description: Prominent French arbitrator Matthieu de Boisséson says he will challenge a decision by London set Littleton Chambers to suspend him following the publication of emails suggesting he was in contact with convicted child sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Álvarez returns to ICSID as deputy secretary-general
item.description: Gabriela Álvarez Ávila has been elected as deputy secretary-general to ICSID, to which she returns 25 years after she first joined and after nearly a decade in private practice at DLA Piper and Curtis.

item.title: Clyde & Co practice chair departs for Keystone
item.description: Ben Knowles, chair of the global arbitration group at Clyde & Co, has left the firm after more than three decades to join Keystone Law in London.

item.title: Dutch retailer takes Serbia to ICSID
item.description: A Dutch retailer says it has launched an ICSID claim against Serbia over a government decree capping profit margins on food and consumer goods.

item.title: GAR awards - the final shortlists
item.description: GAR can reveal the final shortlists for this year's GAR Awards – celebrating the year's most impressive arbitrators, institutions and regional practices.

item.title: Dominican Republic threatens claim against Vinci
item.description: The Dominican Republic says it may pursue arbitration against Vinci over a delayed project to build a new airport terminal – as the French construction group reaches a provisional settlement of an ICSID claim against Chile.

item.title: Saudi "ecosystem" showcased in Riyadh
item.description: At the Saudi Centre for Commercial Arbitration's fifth annual conference during Riyadh International Disputes Week, Hamed Merah, the centre's CEO, provided an overview of the Saudi arbitration "ecosystem", including details of the new draft arbitration law and the award annulment rate by Saudi appeal courts over a five year period.

item.title: Singapore rig builder brings another claim against Petrobras
item.description: Singaporean engineering group Seatrium says it has filed a new UNCITRAL claim against Brazil’s national oil and gas company Petrobras over a legacy contract for an offshore rig that came under scrutiny by Brazilian authorities.

item.title: Iraq beats bulk of power plant claim
item.description: A tribunal has found Iraq liable in a treaty dispute with a Lebanese investor over an US$800 million project to repair and run an oil-fired power plant in Baghdad, while refusing to grant most of the damages sought.
